dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous 2D geometric narrowing observed from the mid-lateral widest point toward the posterior terminal region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical convexity on the left mid-lateral edge relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity consistent with a uniform medium grey tone across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker pixel clusters localized around the blowhole and anterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary grey baseline and localized darker tonal regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast vertical linear white mark along the posterior dorsal midline; multiple small punctate light-pixel marks on the left mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear light-colored mark on the posterior dorsal surface, likely representing a healed scar or epidermal abrasion.
